description: Values extracted from each institution's official Common Data Set 2025-2026 document. Every value lists the source line it was read from. Fields that could not be read unambiguously are omitted (shown as 'Not available').
method: pdftotext -layout + field parser; every value reviewed against its source line; validated with field-specific ranges and cross-field rules. C7 included only when at least 17 factors were read.
